name: AdrenalLLM-Benchmark
description:
AdrenalQA-Bench is a benchmark dataset for evaluating large language models in the medical question-answering domain, specifically focused on adrenal nodules.
The dataset consists of the top 50 most frequently asked patient questions related to adrenal nodules. These questions were curated from common patient concerns, including diagnosis, imaging interpretation, treatment decisions, surgical indications, and long-term management.

reputation: A niche, specialist dataset used for evaluating clinical QA about adrenal nodules; limited but growing adoption in medical LLM evaluation.
